Hello, I’m leaving the farm where I’ve been working with my boyfriend, and we’re looking for a room in Brisbane as we’ll be working there.
He’s 31 and I’m 26; we’re very tidy and respectful.
We’ve been working on a farm for a month and a half, but we’ve decided to move back to the city.
We’re very interested.
We would like to come Friday and to stay until 7 June. 
Have a good day. 😊

Hi! We're doing inspections tonight at 8pm.
Would you like to come?
📍 37 Marian St, Coorparoo QLD 4151
Mathis will be there to assist you.
Message when you arrive: +61 411 590 261
